Model equations and interpretation

The simulation prescribes a metric and integrates test photons in its symmetry plane using fourth-order Runge–Kutta. The heatmap rescales to the selected field and emphasizes faint values. Coordinates use geometric units (G = c = 1) and an arbitrary length unit ℓ. Scaling a model to a different physical size changes its required density. Moving bubbles use comoving coordinates, so photon motion on screen is relative to the bubble.

These geometries are mathematical experiments. A viable drive would need a realizable matter source and a way to create, control, and sustain the geometry.
